thread:
maria: Quick heads-up — I opened a deploybot unpin request for runtime v3.1.2 in eu-west1 canary for tonight's rollout. Targeting 23:30 UTC change window.

deploybot: Unpin request queued: runtime=v3.1.2 scope=canary region=eu-west1 requester=@maria. Use `deploybot approve 3966543210` to proceed.

sam: @maria quick question — are we sure clients in eu-west1 are on SDK >=2.8? I saw a handful still on 2.7.

maria: Good catch. Telemetry shows ~92% on 2.8, ~8% on 2.7 (mostly internal infra bots). Plan was to rely on runtime backwards-compat shim, but want to avoid errors.

devon: If 2.7 calls the new runtime, there's a known header mismatch leading to 400s for function calls — we should either limit canary to 5% or enable compatibility-mode on the shim.

alexa: Ops note — eu-west1 has a slower rollout cadence due to the gateway proxy config. If we limit to 5% we should pin the remaining traffic to runtime v3.1.1 until SDK reach is >=99%.

maria: Proposal: 1) Approve canary unpin at 23:30 UTC at 5% traffic; 2) Enable runtime compatibility-mode flag for the canary pods (`RUNTIME_COMPAT_MODE=legacy-headers`); 3) Postpone full unpin until SDK >=99% (monitoring window 24h). Thoughts?

sam: +1 for the flag. How invasive is `RUNTIME_COMPAT_MODE`? Any perf impact?

devon: Minor CPU increase (~2-3%) on token-heavy workloads. Bench shows tail latency unaffected. Worth it to avoid 400s.

maria: OK approving canary with flag. @deploybot approve 3966543210 (scheduling at 23:30 UTC).

deploybot: Approved by @maria. Scheduled: 2026-01-12T23:30:00Z. Canary config: traffic=5%, region=eu-west1, flags=[RUNTIME_COMPAT_MODE=legacy-headers]. Canary run id: cb-396654.

alexa: Runbook checklist — add these steps under the canary run:
- verify 2xx rate >= 99.5% (per-route)
- check function-calls 4xx spike > 0.1% -> abort
- watch origin SDK rollout metric (sdk.version:2.7 -> 0.0%)

sam: Also add a quick smoke script: `curl -H "X-SDK-Version:2.7" https://eu-west1.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` expecting 200/ok.

maria: Will run smoke and record results in the canary thread. If we see >0.5% 4xx, we'll rollback to v3.1.1 and re-pin.

devon: Rollback command: `deploy runtime rollback --target v3.1.1 --scope canary --region eu-west1 --run cb-396654` — ops should be ready.

alexa: Noted. I'll standby on alerts and mute unrelated noise. Setting alert thresholds now.

(23:29 UTC) maria: launching smoke now before scheduled window.

maria: smoke: `200 OK` with X-Compat-Mode header present. No 4xx observed on 200 requests.

(23:31 UTC) deploybot: Canary rollout started: cb-396654. Traffic split=5% -> v3.1.2 (compat-mode enabled).

sam: Observability: 2xx=99.98%, 4xx=0.02% (within baseline). No function call 4xx spikes.

(23:45 UTC) alexa: Metrics hold steady. SDK telemetry shows gradual 2.7 -> 2.8 drift as expected.

maria: Great. We'll keep canary at 5% for 4h, then re-evaluate for staged increase. Recording action: do not increase traffic unless SDK >=95% or no regressions after 4h.

devon: One caveat — long-sequence workloads saw a small memory bump (~60MB) under compat-mode during load. Ops should watch OOMs.

alexa: Setting OOM alert: group=eng-runtime, threshold=2 OOMs / 15m -> pager.

(03:30 UTC next day) deploybot: Canary cb-396654 steady for 4h; no abort signal. Suggested next step: staged rollout to 20% between 03:45-04:00 UTC.

maria: Holding until SDK >=95% — current SDK is 93.6% in eu-west1. Waiting.

sam: ETA for SDK 95% is ~3 hours (scheduled agent upgrade batch).

maria: Ok, will re-evaluate at 06:30 UTC. If still under 95%, we'll keep canary and coordinate devx to speed up SDK patch.

devon: Logging note for release notes: document compat-mode and the memory bump, plus the rollback command. Also include the SDK timeline requirement and canary id cb-396654.

alexa: I'll draft a short note in release-notes channel after full unpin.

maria: Thanks everyone. Closing thread for now; will update at 06:30 UTC with status. :thumbsup:
